title: platform-admin re-anchor L7 (docs): authorization + permission-sets pages and the operator runbook for the admin-email variable
body:
Leg **L7** of the accepted #11663 platform-admin re-anchor design. Provenance: design document = #11663 comment 5394453215 (§6 row L7); maintainer acceptance = #11663 comment 5404675670 (2026-08-25, verbatim 「接受你的建议，继续」). Filed by PM session `session_01KWRU3s15AJz7PGW7a7wdCh`.

Blocked-by: #11970
Blocked-by: #11974

**Surface**: `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx` (the design cites lines 116, 336, 385, 412 — re-locate on the current tree, the numbers will have drifted), `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx:153`, plus an operator runbook section for `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` (list form, verified-email requirement, fail-closed empty config, revocation = config change + reload). ⛔ Never `content/docs/releases/**` — release notes are compiled centrally at release time.

**Acceptance criterion**: every doc claim about platform-admin derivation matches the landed L2/L4 behaviour on `origin/main` (verified against the code, not against the design); the runbook states the fail-closed and unparseable-entry-fails-whole-variable semantics in operator language.
